dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: What do you think? If you think you can handle these tasks, feel free to give them a go.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: If you're able to complete them successfully, the citizens will trust you more, and you'll be allowed to take on still more important work.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: As the tasks you undertake grow in importance, so too will the amount the Knights will pay you as compensation.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: After all, while you are an Honorary Knight, the citizens don't know you too well yet.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: If you wish to earn their trust, you need to interact with them more.

dialogues.speaker: Hertha
dialogues.text: Well, that's the long and short of it. I'll leave it to you to decide on the tasks you wish to take up.
